requirements.requirement: The product is in HS heading 19.01.
requirements.evidence: The declared HS code is 1901.10. The product description fits heading 19.01: “Infant cereal (precooked millet and soya with milk powder), for infants and young children, 400 g cartons”.

requirements.requirement: Imported ingredients of heading 19.01 are at most 15% of the ex-works price.
requirements.evidence: Cereal-based premix preparation may be an imported ingredient of heading 19.01. The value, HS code or origin is missing or the documents do not agree. The share cannot be calculated yet.

requirements.requirement: The work done in Ghana is more than simple operations such as mixing or packing.
requirements.evidence: These steps in Ghana are more than simple operations: roasting of millet and soya, cooking by extrusion and drum drying of the cooked paste.

requirements.requirement: No ingredient comes from food aid.
requirements.evidence: The production notes state that no ingredient comes from food aid.

requirements.requirement: There is proof of origin for local and AfCFTA ingredients.
requirements.evidence: Supplier declarations or certificates are on file for 2 of 2 ingredients from Ghana or other AfCFTA countries.
